excerpt: Contribute to lamarcol/NotBot development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
NotBot is an experimental Python project that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze financial news and calculate an aggregated sentiment score for publicly traded companies.

The project was developed to explore the application of artificial intelligence to financial markets, combining news analysis, financial data, and automated processing.

Features

  • Multi-source news collection: Retrieves financial news from Google News and Finnhub.
  • LLM-based sentiment analysis: Uses Google Gemini and Groq models to evaluate news sentiment.
  • Weighted sentiment scoring: Considers article content, source reliability, and publication recency.
  • News deduplication: Filters similar articles to reduce the influence of repeated events.
  • Asynchronous processing: Uses aiohttp and asyncio to retrieve and process multiple articles efficiently.
  • Market data integration: Experimental support for historical end-of-day prices through FMP.

How It Works

  1. The user selects a company or stock ticker.
  2. NotBot collects recent financial news from multiple sources.
  3. Articles are extracted, filtered, and deduplicated.
  4. LLMs evaluate the sentiment of the selected articles.
  5. Individual scores are combined into a weighted sentiment indicator.
  6. The program generates a report summarizing the results.

Technologies

  • Language: Python
  • AI: Google Gemini, Groq
  • News processing: feedparser, Beautiful Soup, trafilatura, googlenewsdecoder
  • Asynchronous operations: aiohttp, asyncio
  • Financial data: Finnhub, Financial Modeling Prep

Installation

Clone the repository and install the dependencies. In PowerShell:

git clone https://github.com/lamarcol/NotBot.git
cd NotBot
python -m pip install -r PosNegNeut/requirements.txt
Copy-Item .env.example .env

Add your API keys to .env and set the target company and ticker in PosNegNeut/parole_chiave.json. Then run:

python PosNegNeut/main.py

Limitations

NotBot is an experimental project, and its sentiment scores have not been systematically validated against financial market performance.

News sentiment does not necessarily predict stock price movements, and results may be affected by incomplete articles, LLM biases, and limited news coverage.

NotBot is not intended to provide financial advice or investment recommendations.
